description.p: Folio is a quiet, native Markdown reader for Linux. Open a local document, follow its headings, search its text, and read in a light or dark theme.

Tables, task lists, fenced code, and local images are supported. Folio reloads documents when they change and never modifies your source files. Everything runs locally, without an account or network access.
Read-only access to your files keeps relative links, nearby images, and automatic reload working across document folders.

description.p: Disable the WebKitGTK DMA-BUF renderer in the Flatpak for reliable document opening on affected Wayland graphics configurations.
Initial release with local Markdown reading, heading navigation, search, themes, and automatic reload.
